name: Arkansas

context: AR 340: Cover crops are used to reduce sheet, rill, and wind erosion.
AR 603: Herbaceous wind barriers apply to cropland where wind erosion is a resource concern.
cover_rules: AR 340: Do not burn cover crop residue. Leave residues on the soil surface.
AR 340: Aim for a minimum of 90-percent combined canopy and surface residue cover during erosive wind or rainfall.
residue: AR 329: Residue shall not be burned; distribute all residues uniformly over the entire field.
barriers: AR 603: Wind barriers have a minimum expected height of 1.5 feet and porosity of 40 to 50 percent; row spacing within the barrier is no greater than 36 inches.
AR 603: Barrier spacing does not exceed 10 times the planned barrier height, set across the prevailing wind erosion direction.
windbreak: AR 380: The protected zone on the leeward side is 10 times the design height (H) of the tallest row at age 20; orient perpendicular to the wind.
seeding: AR 512: Use the current AR NRCS Forage Fact Sheets for seeding rates, seeding dates and depths.
